bias_postal_code_3.description: **Bias by short postal code** Boost addresses with a matching short postal code (five digit ZIP for US addresses).

bias_city.description: **Bias by city** Boost addresses in the named city, town or locality. Case, spaces and accents are ignored. For UK addresses use `bias_posttown`.

is_business.description: **Filter by business address** `true` restricts results to business addresses; `false` excludes them. For US addresses this is derived from the USPS record type (`F`, a firm record).
